candidates.change_summary: Delete the revert guard so SetMinSum always updates MinSum.
Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); guard so that SetMinSum can be called multiple times and overwrite the previously set MinSum.
Delete the MinSum = _val; assignment so that SetMinSum does not actually change the state variable.
Replace MinSum = _val; with MinSum = _val + 1; so that the stored value is always one greater than the argument.
Replace the if(intitalized)revert(); check with require(intitalized, ""); so that SetLogFile can be called multiple times after initialization, changing the LogFile address.
Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); revert guard, allowing SetLogFile to be called any number of times before or after initialization.
Delete the balance update `acc.balance += msg.value` so the contract tracks an incorrect balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value` with `acc.balance += msg.value + 1` so the stored balance is always 1 wei greater than the actual deposit.
Replace `acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp+_lockTime` with `acc.unlockTime=block.timestamp` so the unlock time ignores the provided lock time parameter.
Delete the unlock time update so the unlock time is never extended by subsequent deposits.
